c2-michelin-kitchen-stage.text: New cooks need to hit the ground running here.
c2-michelin-kitchen-stage.translation: Los cocineros nuevos deben arrancar a toda marcha aquí. (hit the ground running)
c2-michelin-kitchen-stage.apply_sentence: The new manager had to ____ on day one.
c2-michelin-kitchen-stage.apply_translation: La nueva gerente tuvo que arrancar a toda marcha desde el primer día.
c2-michelin-kitchen-stage.glossary_meaning: hit the ground running: empezar a tope

c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.text: We shouldn't throw the baby out with the bathwater.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.translation: No deberíamos tirar lo bueno junto con lo malo. (throw the baby out with the bathwater)
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.apply_sentence: Criticize the plan, yet don't ____ entirely.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.apply_answer: throw the baby out with the bathwater
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.apply_translation: Critica el plan, pero no deseches todo, lo bueno con lo malo.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.glossary_word: throw the baby out with the bathwater
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.glossary_meaning: throw the baby out with the bathwater: descartar lo bueno

c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.text: Modernists aren't trying to reinvent the wheel, merely refine it.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.translation: Los modernistas no intentan reinventar la rueda, solo refinarla. (reinvent the wheel)
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.apply_sentence: We don't need to ____ every time we start a project.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.apply_translation: No necesitamos reinventar la rueda cada vez que empezamos un proyecto.
c2-molecular-gastronomy-symposium.glossary_meaning: reinvent the wheel: reinventar lo ya inventado

c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.text: This one flavor is merely the tip of the iceberg.
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.translation: Este sabor es solo la punta del iceberg. (the tip of the iceberg: solo una pequeña parte)
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.apply_translation: Esas quejas eran solo la punta del iceberg.
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.glossary_meaning: the tip of the iceberg: la punta del iceberg

c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.text: We had to bite the bullet and reject the cheaper oil.
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.translation: Tuvimos que apechugar y rechazar el aceite más barato. (bite the bullet: afrontar algo difícil)
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.apply_sentence: I'll have to ____ and tell her the truth.
c2-olive-oil-terroir-panel.apply_translation: Tendré que apechugar y decirle la verdad.
